mentions.name: Local desktop/web image app (UI mockups)
mentions.description: An early-stage local desktop/web application for image processing/creative effects, currently at the UI mockup stage with some features functional and experiments with CSS/SVG masks; the builders note they lack the UI and vision expertise to take it to completion.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on some image stuff and want to build a local desktop/web application, here are some UI mockups of that I've been playing with (many AI generated though some of the features are functional, I realized that with CSS/SVG masks you can do a ton more than you'd expect): https://i.imgur.com/SFOX4wB.png https://i.imgur.com/sPKRRTx.png but we don't have all the ui/vision expertise we'd need to take them to completion most likely.
